title: fj-queue v1 snapshot
description: Open additive-only inner objects: new optional fields land in v1.x without bumping `schema_version`. The top-level oneOf branches (`SuccessEnvelope`, `ErrorEnvelope`) are closed only to disambiguate the two envelope shapes. Removal or repurposing of an existing key bumps `schema_version`.

schema_version.description: Wire-contract version. Bumped on breaking change.

as_of.description: RFC3339 UTC timestamp of the snapshot fetch. 'Z' suffix; second precision.

host.description: Forgejo host the snapshot was taken from.

filter.description: Echoes the --repo / --label scoping passed on the CLI. null fields mean unscoped.

schedulable_labels.description: Alphabetically sorted union of ONLINE runners' labels.

runners.description: Every known runner (including offline). Sorted by name.

totals.description: Instance-wide counts, even when filter.repo/label is set.

per_repo.description: Per-repo breakdown. Sorted by repo slug.

queue.description: WAITING jobs only. Sorted by job_id ascending (FIFO approximation).

warnings.description: Structured warning rows. Sorted by job_id.

runner_pods.description: Per-pod runner CPU/memory from Prometheus (combined containers). Raw numbers, not human-formatted. Sorted by pod name. Empty when metrics are disabled or the fetch failed (see `metrics.error`).

metrics.description: Metadata about the runner-metrics fetch. `error` is null on success and the failure reason string on a Prometheus problem (in which case `runner_pods` is []).

rate_window.description: CPU rate window used by the per-pod query (e.g. "5m").

ncps.description: NCPS (nix cache proxy) cache activity from Prometheus, or null when metrics are disabled or the NCPS fetch failed.

ErrorEnvelope.description: Emitted to stdout on failure. Human diagnostics go to stderr. Exit code is derived from `error.code`: usage=2, auth=3, connection=4, schema_drift=5, internal=1.

status.description: Forgejo runner status. Not enum-constrained in swagger; defensive parse may include unknown values.

online.description: Derived: true iff status in {active, idle}.

task_id.description: null while waiting (Forgejo emits 0 on the wire; fj-queue normalizes the sentinel); non-zero integer once a runner picks the job up.

blocked_reason.description: null while running; one of the strings while waiting.

node.description: Kubernetes node the pod runs on. Used for the blue/green cluster filter (node prefix k8s-node-* / k8s-node-*).

cpu_cores.description: 5m-rate CPU usage in cores, combined across the pod's containers.

memory_bytes.description: Working-set memory in raw bytes, combined across the pod's containers.

cpu_limit_cores.description: Configured CPU limit in cores, summed across containers. null when no CPU limit is set (the current reality for these pods).

memory_limit_bytes.description: Configured memory limit in raw bytes, summed across containers. null when no memory limit is set.

active.description: true iff NCPS is serving requests (requests_per_sec > 0) or has in-flight requests; otherwise idle.

requests_per_sec.description: Requests/sec served by NCPS over the rate window.

upstream_per_sec.description: Upstream fetches/sec = cache misses (NCPS pulling from cache.nixos.org).

bytes_per_sec.description: Bytes/sec served over the rate window.

code.description: Structured warning code. M3 currently emits only `unschedulable_labels`; additive in future versions.
